Usage: yantra schedule [options] <workflow-name>

Register a recurring unattended run of a saved workflow

Arguments:
  workflow-name                Name of the saved workflow to schedule

Options:
  --cron <expr>                Cron expression (e.g. "0 8 * * 1")
  -p, --params <key=value...>  Workflow parameter (repeatable) (default: [])
  --params-file <path>         YAML/JSON file of parameter key-value pairs
  --notify <target>            Notification sink: desktop | file | none
                               (default: "desktop")
  --on-confirm <policy>        Confirmation policy — only "pause-and-notify" is
                               accepted (default: "pause-and-notify")
  --json                       Emit JSON summary to stdout (default: false)
  --debug                      Verbose logging to stderr (default: false)
  -h, --help                   display help for command
